description: Main backend API implementation for the CodeReview Assistant, providing user authentication, repository upload, analysis endpoints, and utility functions for running git diff, ripgrep, and interfacing with an LLM for code suggestions and issues.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user.

classes.name: AnalysisResultRead
classes.description: Schema for returning analysis result details.

classes.name: GenericResponse
classes.description: Generic schema for API responses with a detail message.

methods.name: register(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user.

methods.name: login(form: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and create session token.

methods.name: get_user_by_token(token: str, db: Session)
methods.description: Utility to retrieve user session info by token.

methods.name: get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Dependency to retrieve currently authenticated user.

methods.name: str save_upload_file_tmp(upload_file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Saves uploaded file to temporary location.

methods.name: upload_repo( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles uploading and extracting a repo archive.

methods.name: cleanup(*paths)
methods.description: Removes files or directories used during upload process.

methods.name: analyze_repo( upload_id: int = Form(..., description="Upload ID returned from /repo/upload"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Runs code analysis on the uploaded repository.

methods.name: str try_git_diff(path: str)
methods.description: Generates git diff output for a given repo path.

methods.name: str try_ripgrep(path: str)
methods.description: Runs ripgrep to search codebase for patterns.

methods.name: call_llm_tools(git_diff: str, rg_results: str, repo_path: str)
methods.description: Mocks calling LLM APIs for code suggestions and issues.

methods.name: get_analysis(upload_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves analysis results for a specific upload.

methods.name: get_history(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models_module.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves full analysis history for the current user.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Simple health check endpoint.
